title: Take your doubt to saintly company
summary: The line does not reward endless circling; it asks for trust, keeping, and return. Do not let the day outrun this: carry this with you: ask for the guidance that can lead you through ego's curtain.
takeaway: Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
lifeApplication: When confusion starts multiplying explanations, stop reading and move toward living company. Ask one clear question where peace is already embodied.

source.shortMeaning: Doubt clears when it seeks living guidance instead of circling alone.
source.lifeApplication: When doubt starts roaming, ask one clear question in living company.
